text:
Alex H: Heads-up — starting account + project for ap-south-2 GPU fleet. Need VPC scaffold that supports IPv6 (dual-stack), reserved CIDR plan, and a handoff doc for networking + security. Target: 2x A100 nodes first week. ETA: provisioning window Tue 09:00 IST. :wave:

Maya R: noted. do we have quota request in with cloud? I’ll check GPU quota and vCPUs. Also need to confirm service endpoints for ECR/S3.

Chris N: I'll prep terraform module. Prefer using existing aws-vpc module but add ipv6_enabled = true and ipv6_cidr_block = "auto". Also want egress-only IGW for IPv6.

Jordan P: infra-bot kicked off project creation? we need project id, billing, and folder mapping for cost center.

infra-bot: New cloud-account created: project redwood-ap-south2-gpu (proj-1234). Billing link: https://billing.internal/projects/proj-1234

Alex H: Add required IAM roles: redwood-gpu-node-role, redwood-network-admin. KMS key must be in same region. Need compliance tag: pci=false, pii=false for this project.

Maya R: GPU quota OK, requested vCPU increase (req #4521). Expect approval by EOD Mon. Note: AZ capacity in ap-south-2 may be limited for 8x A100 in a single AZ — plan to spread across two AZs.

Chris N: Terraform sketch (will push to infra repo):
```terraform
module "vpc_ap_south_2" {
  source       = "github.com/redwood/vpc-module"
  region       = "ap-south-2"
  cidr_block   = "10.96.0.0/16"
  ipv6_enabled = true
  public_subnets = ["10.96.0.0/20","10.96.16.0/20"]
  private_subnets = ["10.96.32.0/19","10.96.64.0/19"]
  tags = { env = "prod", team = "inference" }
}
```

Alex H: Good. Reserve a /56 for IPv6 allocation and document it in the runbook. Add route table entries for IPv6 ::/0 -> egress-only-igw and IPv4 0.0.0.0/0 -> NAT gateway.

Maya R: Security groups: allow 22 from SRE bastion only, 9443 from LB, and ephemeral ports 1024-65535 for internal subnets. Enable VPC Flow Logs to central logging account.

Jordan P: I'll handle TGW attachment and peering with central VPC. We also need VPN for on-prem model artifact sync and a dedicated S3 endpoint policy.

infra-bot: terraform plan for redwood-ap-south2-gpu completed — 12 resources to add. Plan url: https://terraform.plan/abcd :eyes:

Chris N: Quick validation checklist to include in handoff:
- [ ] Cloud project created and ID documented
- [ ] Quota increases confirmed
- [ ] VPC CIDR and IPv6 allocation noted
- [ ] Subnet AZ mapping and names
- [ ] Route tables, NAT and egress-only IGW configured
- [ ] Security groups and NACLs reviewed
- [ ] KMS key created and policy attached
- [ ] Flow logs and TGW peering tested
- [ ] Bastion + SSM configured
- [ ] Cost estimate updated (monthly GPU commit + network egress)

Alex H: Cost note — initial reserved capacity estimate: 2x A100 = ~$10k/mo on commit; add egress budget $500/mo. Put numbers in ticket.

Maya R: I'll run connectivity tests post-deploy. ping me when apply finishes.

infra-bot: terraform apply succeeded (apply-id: apply-789). Resources created: vpc-0abc, igw-0def, eip-1, subnet-0aaa, subnet-0bbb :white_check_mark:

Chris N: Post-deploy validation steps I ran:
- checked instance metadata and IAM role attach
- verified IPv6 assignment: `ip -6 addr show eth0`
- S3 access via VPC endpoint (no public egress)
- verified NTP (chrony) sync to region pool
- ran small redis KV latency checks to central cache (p95 ~ 6ms)

Jordan P: Handoff doc created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/networking/ap-south-2-dualstack-vpc.md — includes subnet map, terraform outputs, and reviewer checklist. Adding to oncall rotation.

Alex H: Thanks all. @Maya R @Jordan P please add your names to the runbook reviewers and confirm quotas in the doc. Scheduling handoff call Wed 10:30 IST. :calendar:

Maya R: reviewers added, quota ticket link included. I'll post validation logs after smoke tests.

End of thread.
